saw_lines: Bag buyers pick by daily fit and keep one for years, so the first order is often the only one.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer weighs whether the bag fits their day.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number at all, so collect one review count or orders shipped and open every next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no reason to trust the claim before clicking. Collect one number, a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
5 of your 30 ads say Shop now but send buyers to the homepage, not the product. A buyer who clicks a bag and lands on a generic page has to search again. Point each one to the bag it shows.
None of your 30 ads mention an offer or discount, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Put one reason in front of them, a first order offer or a bundle, and test it on three new ads.

Your copy ads open with 19 different stories, and the biggest one leads 6 of them, so the account has no clear opener to build on. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from those two only.

ads_1: Two best openers rebuilt as bag-fit video, each ending on a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
